info.title: Oya Browser API
info.description: REST API for controlling browsers connected to the Oya Browser server. Browsers connect via WebSocket; AI tools and clients use this REST API (or MCP) to send commands.

get.description: Returns browsers connected with the caller's API key. Admin keys see all browsers.

post.description: Starts a browser as one of the caller's personas: on the key's provider, in a sandbox, or on a CDP endpoint the caller names (any Chrome with --remote-debugging-port). Answers 201 with the browser's id and its gateway CDP URL. A second start on an endpoint another browser already holds answers 409 endpoint_in_use; the body names the holder's id when it is yours.

persona.description: A persona id, or "auto" for a fresh one.

provider.description: cdp, oya-cloud, oya-selfhosted, or a vendor; defaults to the key's configured provider.

wsUrl.description: For provider cdp: the ws://, wss:// or http:// address of the debugging port.

name.description: A display name for the browser.

201.description: The browser is ready to drive.

cdpUrl.description: The gateway CDP URL for this browser.

400.description: A field was malformed; the body names it.

409.description: Endpoint already held by a running browser (endpoint_in_use), or the session may not go on.

429.description: The key or persona is at its browser quota.

502.description: The provider or endpoint could not be reached.

post.description: Attaches a browser the server dials out to, with no persona: any Chrome with --remote-debugging-port, or a vendor session. A second attach on an endpoint another browser already holds answers 409 endpoint_in_use; the body names the holder's id when it is yours.

wsUrl.description: The ws://, wss:// or http:// address of the debugging port.

name.description: A display name for the browser.

400.description: A field was malformed; the body names it.

409.description: Endpoint already held by a running browser (endpoint_in_use).

429.description: The key is at its browser quota.

502.description: Could not attach to the CDP browser.

post.summary: Send a command to a browser
post.description: Execute a browser action (analyze, navigate, click, type, press_key, screenshot, scroll, wait, list_tabs, open_tab, switch_tab, close_tab, read_page).

action.description: The browser action to execute. Each action uses only specific params (see examples).

params.description: Action-specific parameters. Only include params relevant to the chosen action.

selector.description: CSS selector, e.g. [data-ac-id="3"] (for click, type, wait, read_page)

key.description: Key to press (for press_key): Enter, Escape, Tab, Backspace, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, etc.

500.description: Server fault, not the request: the body carries a ref that matches the server's log line

post.description: Send a conversation to the LLM which uses browser tools to complete tasks. The LLM autonomously calls analyze_page, click, type, etc. until the task is done.

toolCalls.description: Tools the LLM called during execution

replayable.description: Whether the run acted on a page and can be saved as a playbook (POST /api/browsers/{browserId}/playbooks)

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream of JPEG frames from the browser. Authorization header, or a single-use ?ticket= from POST /api/control/sessions/{id}/ticket for EventSource, which cannot set headers.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: API key (alternative to Authorization header, for EventSource)

200.description: SSE stream of base64 JPEG frames

schema.description: Each event contains a data: line with a base64-encoded JPEG data URL

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for AI tool integration (Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.). Implements the MCP Streamable HTTP transport.

get.description: Returns pool size and list of connected browsers sharing the caller's API key.

post.description: Send a command to the next browser in the pool via round-robin. Response includes _browser field showing which browser handled it.

action.description: Command action (navigate, analyze, click, type, etc.)

_browser.description: Browser ID that handled the command

get.description: The cookies of one of the caller's personas: the logins its browsers share. `format=playwright` answers the shape `context.addCookies()` takes; `format=netscape` answers a cookies.txt download for curl, wget and yt-dlp.

parameters.name: persona
parameters.description: Persona id; the key's default persona when omitted.

put.summary: Import cookies into a persona's jar
put.description: Merges cookies into one of the caller's persona jars. The persona's browsers pick them up on their next visit to each site. Use it to bring in logins exported from another browser, or to copy one persona's logins to another. Audited.

parameters.name: persona
parameters.description: Persona id; the key's default persona when omitted.

expirationDate.description: Seconds since the epoch; `expires` is accepted too. Omit for a session cookie.

skipped.description: Cookies without a name, value or domain, or already expired.

400.description: No cookie list, or more than 20000 cookies

post.description: Generate N API keys in one call. Admin key required. Use query param or body to specify count (max 10000).

MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint for the browser pool. Round-robins commands across all browsers sharing the caller's API key. navigate/analyze_page advance the round-robin; click/type/screenshot stay pinned to the last-used browser.

200.description: MCP JSON-RPC response or SSE stream

bearerAuth.description: API key passed as Bearer token. Create one from the dashboard after signing in.

error.description: What happened, why, and the next step. Stands alone: clients show it as is.

code.description: A stable reason to branch on: invalid_request, not_found, internal_error, command_outcome_unknown, action_unknown, action_unsupported, action_forbidden, tab_unprotected, endpoint_in_use, provider_failed, quota_exceeded, llm_unconfigured, and others named per route.

field.description: For invalid_request: the field that was wrong.

ref.description: For internal_error: eight hex characters that also sit in the server's log line for this failure.

browserId.description: For endpoint_in_use: the browser that holds the endpoint.

action.description: For action_unknown, action_unsupported and action_forbidden: the action as sent.

clientType.description: For action_unsupported: this browser's kind, oya or cdp.

supportedOn.description: For action_unsupported: the kinds of browser that do the action.

actions.description: On one browser's detail: the actions it does, sorted, one spelling each.

code.description: For ok:false, a stable reason: command_failed for a refusal the page answered, or one named per action.

screenshot.description: Base64 PNG data URL (for screenshot action)

format.description: The format page is written in (for analyze action)

page.description: The page, written in format (for analyze action)

markdown.description: Page content as markdown, when format is markdown (for analyze action)

blocks.description: The page as data: one block per heading, paragraph, list item, table row, image and element, in reading order (for analyze action)

error.description: Error message if ok is false
